_doc: Neighbourhood zones for the Walnut Creek rental map: each zone = a group of faces cut along major roads, creeks, the Contra Costa Canal, BART and open-space edges (build_faces.py). Face ids are positional, so re-check this grouping whenever build_faces.py's split lines change. Names: a name locals or listing sites use where the zone clearly matches it (Census places, OpenStreetMap, city-data.com's neighborhood list); otherwise the zone's anchor streets.

zones.name: Contra Costa Centre
zones.sub: Mid-rise apartments by Pleasant Hill BART · built ~1990s

zones.name: Shadelands
zones.sub: Office park, houses and some apartments

zones.name: Rossmoor
zones.note: Rossmoor is an age-restricted adult community: its own rules say no one under 18 may live there, so a household with children can't rent here.
